evidence.prompt: Evaluate our current incident-diagnosis workflow against an improved prompt and context-retrieval strategy using the same recorded incidents. Include different routers, topology sizes, rare failures, and ambiguous evidence. Compare diagnosis accuracy, latency, tool usage, incorrect repair suggestions, and correct human escalations. Recommend improvements only when supported by evaluation results.
